headline: Assaí Reports Q3 2026 Profit of R$248 Million
summary: Assaí recorded a recurring net profit of R$248 million for the third quarter of 2026, a 55% increase. The company noted that October sales rose 3.9% as consumer spending patterns shifted.
why: Assaí is a major Brazilian wholesale retailer, and its sales data provides insight into consumer spending trends in the Brazilian economy.

impacts.name: Assaí
impacts.why: Profit growth was reported, but the result fell short of analyst expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: While profit increased significantly, the actual result of R$248 million missed the R$363 million consensus estimate from analysts.
